# Nereus

> A composable API platform: reefs add the APIs, Nereids look after them, installed at runtime

## Home

- [Home](https://docs.getnereus.dev/index.md): Know what Nereus is and where to start

## Start

- [Install the CLI](https://docs.getnereus.dev/start/install.md): Install the nereus CLI on Linux and check that it answers
- [Write the settings](https://docs.getnereus.dev/start/settings.md): Write the settings file and see what init would do, with nothing created
- [Prepare the cluster](https://docs.getnereus.dev/start/init.md): Prepare a local cluster with nereus init
- [Look around](https://docs.getnereus.dev/start/look-around.md): See the installation, its reefs and its Nereids
- [Apply a reef and its Nereid](https://docs.getnereus.dev/start/first-reef.md): Apply a reef, the Nereid that serves it and the Mandate that binds them
- [Run its commands](https://docs.getnereus.dev/start/run.md): Run the commands a reef's Nereid adds to the CLI
- [Clean up](https://docs.getnereus.dev/start/clean-up.md): Delete the Nereid and the cluster

## Concepts

- [What Nereus is](https://docs.getnereus.dev/concepts/what-is-nereus.md): Understand what Nereus is and what it is not
- [Reef, Nereid and Mandate](https://docs.getnereus.dev/concepts/model.md): Understand reefs, Nereids and Mandates, the three words of the Nereus model
- [Runtime install and profiles](https://docs.getnereus.dev/concepts/runtime-and-profiles.md): Understand how reefs and Nereids are installed at runtime and what a profile is
- [Undercloud and overcloud](https://docs.getnereus.dev/concepts/undercloud-overcloud.md): Understand the undercloud and the overcloud
- [Tenancy and access](https://docs.getnereus.dev/concepts/tenancy-and-access.md): Understand whose each thing is and who may do what
- [The Nereus API](https://docs.getnereus.dev/concepts/nereus-api.md): Understand the Nereus API and how the CLI and the portal use it

## Guides

- [Keep the CLI up to date](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/cli-update.md): Keep a nereus installed from a release up to date, or choose how it upgrades
- [Prepare a cluster for Nereus](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/cluster.md): Prepare a cluster that offers what Nereus needs, on k3d or AKS
- [Install with Helm](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/helm.md): Install Nereus and a profile with two Helm charts, without nereus init
- [Deploy main to the live cluster](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/deploy-live.md): Upgrade the live cluster in place to the commit of main, then run its smoke test
- [Rebuild the kept cluster](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/kept-cluster.md): Rebuild the kept cluster that runs Triton from nothing, with its public hostnames
- [Update the kept cluster without a rebuild](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/kept-cluster-update.md): Move one Nereid or the Nereus API of the kept cluster to a new build, without a rebuild
- [Meet the time SLO](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/slo.md): See and change the time objective nereus init is measured against
- [Prepare the undercloud](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/undercloud.md): Create the undercloud, the local cluster whose public issuer a cloud trusts
- [Connect to the cloud](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/cloud.md): Let the Nereid azure reach the cloud with your own login, after you read and approve its plan
- [Publish at a hostname](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/operate/edge.md): Publish a reef's endpoint at a hostname of your own domain, through a Cloudflare tunnel
- [Turn on authentication](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/access/authentication.md): Turn on sign-in, log in as the initial admin, and give the realm a public host
- [Grant access](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/access/grant-access.md): Grant a Nereid the cloud roles it asks for, with your own login
- [Say who may do what](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/access/authorization.md): Give a team a role on a Project, so its members may act there and others may not
- [Know whose each thing is](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/access/tenancy.md): Build the tree of Organizations and Projects that every Workload, Environment and database names as its owner
- [Prove a GitHub App is installed](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/access/github-app.md): Connect a GitHub App to the installation and lend one repository to a consumer for an hour
- [Keep a secret](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/secrets.md): Keep a secret in the installation, encrypted on your machine before it leaves it
- [Use a secret in a namespace](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/secret-binding.md): Give a namespace a Kubernetes Secret made from a secret of the installation
- [Release a chart](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/release.md): Release a Helm chart into a namespace, with its values and its secrets
- [Run a registry](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/registry.md): Run an image registry of your own in the cluster, publish an image to it and run that image
- [Say what Nereus has](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/catalog.md): Register what a repository says it runs and publishes, and check that it holds together
- [Follow the golden path](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/golden-path.md): Run your own image in an Environment of its own, from docker build to a Pod that answers
- [Collect metrics](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/metrics.md): See how each Nereid is doing, in the metrics the platform keeps
- [Connect an organisation](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/scm-connection.md): Connect an organisation of a source host to Nereus through a GitHub App, holding no key
- [Mirror a repository](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/scm-mirror.md): Copy a public Git repository into the cluster, kept in a Forgejo the platform runs
- [Send messages](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/messaging.md): Give a project a topic and a queue on NATS, each with a Secret that says where to reach it
- [Join the team's room](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/team-room.md): Put your coding agent in the team's room on Triton, where the team's agents claim, ask and release
- [Create a room for your team](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/rooms.md): Give your team a second room on Triton, where its agents and people talk apart from the repository's room
- [Use the MCP server](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/mcp.md): Reach the tools of the installed reefs from Claude Code or claude.ai through the Nereus API's /mcp
- [Follow your agent's quota](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/reefs/usage.md): Follow a coding agent's weekly quota, where it is heading at the reset and what today may use
- [Run the CLI from a checkout](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/build/cli-checkout.md): Put an editable nereus on the PATH from a checkout, with Tab completion
- [Start a new Nereid](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/build/new-nereid.md): Start a new Nereid from the template, with its tests passing, ready for the Tool's work
- [Build a Nereid's image](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/build/image.md): Build a Nereid's image with the labels that name its reef, push it and apply it
- [Require a reef](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/build/requires.md): Make a Nereid require another reef, so it is applied only once that reef has a Nereid
- [Pass the conformance tests](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/build/conformance.md): Prove that a Nereid serves every verb of every kind of its reef and honours its contract
- [A name is taken](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/troubleshoot/name-taken.md): Fix an init that stops because the issuer storage account name is taken in Azure
- [When the Nereid stops](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/troubleshoot/nereid-stops.md): Get a reef's commands working again when its Nereid has no pod serving
- [See what happened](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/troubleshoot/see-what-happened.md): Find why a reef, a Nereid or one of its objects is not Ready, from the CLI down to the pod's log
- [The issuer is not public](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/troubleshoot/issuer-not-public.md): Fix a nereid apply azure that stops because the cluster's issuer is not public
- [A cloud request is refused](https://docs.getnereus.dev/guides/troubleshoot/request-refused.md): Go on when a cloud request of an approved plan is refused for a missing right
